correctness.rationale: For 0<p<1 every interior birth/death edge is positive in the independence chain. In the anticonformist chain an upward jump exists at k<N iff k≥3 or N−k≥4, and the downward condition is its reflection. Those conditions cover all required jumps from N=6. At N=4 the exact closed classes are {0,1}, {2}, {3,4}; at N=5 they are {0,1,2}, {3,4,5} throughout 0<p<1. Reflection and uniqueness make the stationary law symmetric. Detailed balance gives successive stationary ratios: with a=(k)_3 and b=(N−k−1)_3 on the upper half, a>b≥0. Cancelling the common positive factors gives for independence a fractional-linear derivative of sign b−a and for anticonformity a derivative numerator 4(b²−a²). All relevant denominators are positive on the stated open domain. Folding preserves the consecutive ratios except for the p-independent factor two on the first even-N step. Therefore the likelihood ratio of the higher-noise radial law relative to the lower-noise law decreases strictly. At any nontrivial cutoff its conditional mean above the cutoff is strictly below its conditional mean below, and normalization puts the former below one. Summing positive step increments yields the expectation comparison on the attainable support. A separate exact rational replay at N=6 gave P(D≥4) of 52/77 then 243/593 for independence, and 1296/1391 then 16/23 for anticonformity, at p=1/4 then 1/2. The bounded replay corroborates but does not prove the all-N result. The supplied source was inspected, not executed. No claim extends to simultaneous four-spin updates or to the absorbing endpoints in noise.

value.rationale: The four-agent rates are motivated by a concrete model, and a distribution-wide stationary comparison answers strictly more than a phase diagram or the location of peaks. It controls every nontrivial finite polarization tail and increasing decision statistic for both noise mechanisms without taking a large-population limit. The sharp N=6 cutoff also identifies precisely when the anticonformist stationary law is unique in this interpretation. These uses do not require extending the conclusion to the microscopic update protocol.
